relations.LRM-R33: a res to a place, declared at res level and many-to-many
relations.LRM-R35: a res to a time-span, declared at res level and many-to-many
relations.LRM-R1: a res to a res, which LRM leaves to an implementation to refine

refinements.name: time-of-capture
refinements.for: when a holding was made, as the holding itself records it. A photograph's own metadata says this; a file's timestamp never does, because it says when the bytes were last written

refinements.name: time-of-publication-or-manufacture
refinements.for: when a manifestation was issued or pressed, as the container states it. This is a property of the edition rather than of the work, which is why it hangs off the manifestation

refinements.name: place-of-capture
refinements.for: where a holding was made. A coordinate answers to the nearest named place and a distance, which is a resemblance rather than an address, so the place recorded is the one the evidence supports

refinements.name: place-within-place
refinements.for: a place inside a larger one, so that a holding placed at a locality is reachable from the region that contains it without the locality being restated

refinements.name: arrangement-position-of-source-numbering
refinements.for: a household's own position for a member against the number a source gives the same member, so that a source numbering a series differently is recorded rather than renumbering what the household holds

refinements.name: same-thing
refinements.for: a res a household made and a res a later release ships for the same concept. Both persist and neither is merged: merging would mutate the seeded row or destroy the local one, and the local one carries the household's own provenance and assigner

refinements.name: extent-of
refinements.for: a temporal address on a release's manifestation and the track manifestation it is the extent of. A release ripped to one file with a cue sheet beside it carries its tracks as positions within the medium rather than as digital items, so analysing a track reads that extent of the release's file

refinements.name: cover-art-of
refinements.for: a cover image and the holding it depicts

refinements.name: lyrics-of
refinements.for: a lyrics file and the recording it carries the words of. A deriving tool reads it into temporal annotations on the track

refinements.name: subtitles-of
refinements.for: a subtitle file and the moving image it is timed against

refinements.name: cue-sheet-of
refinements.for: a cue sheet and the single file whose track positions it states

refinements.name: description-of
refinements.for: a description file and the holding it describes

refinements.name: metadata-of
refinements.for: a metadata sidecar and the holding it asserts about. What it asserts is evidence for matching rather than for placement
